column1: # The upstream text this tree holds in files of kind ours+upstream (MANIFEST.tsv), because the build needs it where it is.
# file: - for the member itself, else a file the member (a patch) writes. how: created (a file the patch creates, byte for byte
# the upstream object), edited (the lines the patch adds to that file are upstream's), every file (the whole patch), derived (an
# upstream file with the mechanical change its origin names), adapted (an edited copy of the upstream file its origin names, or of a
# part of it), encoded (the upstream file's bytes written out as a C byte list), generated (the output of the upstream tool its
# origin names, run on the upstream input it names). bytes, sha256 and git_blob are those the tree holds: the file the patch
# creates, or the member itself; - where there is no such file.
